Lemma
[Geodesics in the upper half-space model] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0196 1. ch31:31.6\group Hyperbolic isometries

All geodesics in $U^n$ are portions of vertical lines or circles meeting the hyperplane at infinity orthogonally.
